newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: U.S. National Rifle Association gets NGO status.
newsitem.headline: U.S. National Rifle Association gets NGO status.

text.p: The National Rifle Association (NRA), the biggest organisation of gun owners in the United States, has received U.N. accreditation as a non-governmental organisation, a U.N. spokesman said on Tuesday.
It joins some 1,700 other groups that have consultative status with the U.N. Economic and Social Council, enabling its representatives to take part in meetings of some subsidiary bodies.
The NRA, which has some three million members, said in its application it hoped to make a "valuable contribution towards the safe and responsible use of firearms," the U.N. spokesman said.
